title: The Spot
overview: Three friends by the name of Jake, Samuel, and Dave decide to visit a local forest preserve to smoke weed on their day off from classes. Jake (Nicholas B. Mora) brings up the idea of going to a particular area that he's familiar with. Along with some drinks and music, the guys are off to have a fun time. On the way to the woods, Jake mentions that he's heard on the news that a guy invited their cousin to the woods only for the police to find 1 of them slaughtered to death near a human bone ritual site........no comment is made on the other cousin. While this story cracks fear into Dave, both Samuel and Jake brush off the subject like it's another day off because they only came to the woods for one reason: to smoke their lungs out; they are in the perfect spot, after all. Meanwhile, an electric, sinister evil is unleashed into the woods, striking down anyone it encounters. This is The Hand of Darkness.
